environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 1 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-validation' at priority 2 that applies a regex pattern constraint on all query string values rejecting strings matching `(?i)(?:union|select|insert|update|delete|drop|exec|;|--|/\*)` with action BLOCK and a 403 response with custom body, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 3 in COUNT mode only (not blocking). The ALB performs TLS termination and forwards X-Forwarded-For. CloudWatch Logs subscription filter triggers a Lambda that updates a DynamoDB blocklist on repeated 403s, but this is async and not inline. The ECS task role has no network egress except to the ALB via security group.

config.network: ECS Fargate, SG allows inbound only from ALB SG on TCP/8080, no direct internet access
config.auth: ALB OIDC authentication action required before forwarding
